Design, artificial intelligence and personalised prosthetics.

A research workspace exploring the integration of artificial intelligence into parametric processes for the development of 3D-printed upper-limb prostheses.

Read the manuscript ↗Explore the resources ↓

01 / THE REPOSITORY

From research to development.

Author
Pedro Miguel Candeias da Silva
Supervisor
Demétrio Ferreira Matos

This repository brings together the dissertation work of Pedro Miguel Candeias da Silva, carried out within the Master’s in Product Design and Development at IPCA, under the supervision of Demétrio Ferreira Matos. It connects the literature review, the development of a parametric platform, and the documentation of fabrication trials and technical assessment.

It provides access to the manuscript, records development decisions, and connects the reported results with the supporting data, models, documents and tools. It also preserves the revision history and supporting research material.

PLATFORM ↗

HandFab

A research prototype for exploring the parametric customisation of prosthetic hands: anthropometric measurements, AI-assisted parameter suggestions, model visualisation and STL export for 3D printing.

The application’s source code and documentation are maintained in a dedicated repository.
